ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Stracciatella Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Stracciatella which executes a Powershell runspace from within C# (aka SharpPick technique) with AMSI, ETW and Script Block Logging disabled based on PE metadata characteristics.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\Stracciatella\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Stracciatella\.exe" OR process_description = "Stracciatella" OR (process_hash = RGX(".*SHA256\\=9d25e61ec1527e2a69d7c2a4e3fe2fe15890710c198a66a9f25d99fdf6c7b956.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA256\\=fd16609bd9830c63b9413671678bb159b89c357d21942ddbb6b93add808d121a.*")))
